PRIZE BONDS RULES, 1999
PRIZE BONDS RULES, 1999
(Addition of Sub-R.(3) in
R.3).)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th September, 2011]
S.R.O.840(I)/2011,
dated 12-9-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 28 of the
Public Debt Act, 1944 (XVII of 1944), the Federal Government is pleased to
direct that the following further amendment shall be made in the Prize Bonds
Rules, 1999, the same having been previously published vide Notification
No.S.R.O.703(I)/2011, dated the 13th July, 2011, as required by section (1) of
the said section, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 3, after sub-rule (2), the following new sub-rule
(3) shall be added, namely:--
"(3) No
office, body, institution or any set up of whatever nature and name other than
those specified under sub-rule (2) shall be authorized to sell, encash or carry
out any business relating to prize bonds or in disguise of prize bonds.".
